title: DSL And Op Text Wave 2: Simple Single-App Technologies
description: Wave 2 of the library/dsl/op/ui split refactor (plan: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/all-technologies-should-be-groovy-wozniak.md). Implement DocumentDsl + OpText (from vcs crate, mechanism ticket TEXTUAL-DSL-OP-LOG-AND-STATEFUL-VCS-MECHANISM) for 8 single-app technologies: layout, lowpoly, raster, writer, sequence, sourcing, shooting, remodel. Each gets a handcrafted textual document format and single-line op syntax, replacing JSON fixtures, with round-trip tests, following the pattern established by the Wave 1 pilots (draw, note).
